About The Role
 Do you thrive in designing and maintaining robust IT infrastructures while ensuring stability, security, and continuous improvement? In this role, you will be responsible for shaping and operating Ascom’s global ICT landscape—covering cloud, on-premise, networking, and communication platforms.
You will act as a key technical expert, ensuring that infrastructure services are always operational, secure, and aligned with business needs, while driving improvements and supporting global ICT initiatives.
You’ll work in an international environment, collaborating with internal stakeholders, vendors, and global teams in line with Ascom’s group-wide standards and best practices.
 What You Will Do (key Responsibilities)
 Infrastructure design & implementation
 Design, implement, and maintain server, networking, and cloud solutions aligned with business requirements
 Ensure systems are kept up to date, secure, and optimized for performance
 Systems installation & operations
 Install and configure software and networking systems
 Ensure stability and availability of IT infrastructure services
 Incident & problem management
 Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, networking, and communication platform issues
 Ensure incidents are handled efficiently and root causes are addressed
 Project leadership & continuous improvement
 Lead and contribute to ICT infrastructure projects and initiatives
 Continuously improve systems, processes, and technologies across the ICT landscape
 Training & knowledge sharing
 Train employees on new hardware and software solutions
 Support knowledge transfer and promote best practices
 Stakeholder & vendor collaboration
 Collaborate with internal teams, external partners, and vendors
 Support coordination across global stakeholders to ensure effective delivery
 Who You Are (personality & Ways Of Working)
 You are a hands-on problem solver who enjoys tackling complex infrastructure challenges
You take ownership and ensure systems are reliable, secure, and continuously improved
 You are a collaborative professional , able to influence without direct authority
You thrive in complex, global environments , balancing operational and strategic needs
You are proactive and driven by continuous improvement and innovation
 What You Bring (experience & Skills)
 Proven experience in ICT infrastructure, networking, and enterprise IT environments
 Strong expertise in:
 Microsoft server environments and system management tools
 Networking (TCP/IP, WAN, LAN)
 Cloud and hybrid infrastructure environments
 Solid understanding of cybersecurity principles and risk mitigation
 Experience in troubleshooting, system optimization, and operational support
 Strong collaboration, communication, and stakeholder management skills
 Ability to manage or contribute to infrastructure projects and initiatives
 Comfortable working in an international, multi-site corporate environment
 Why this role matters (why you should apply)
 You will play a key role in ensuring the stability, security, and evolution of Ascom’s global ICT infrastructure
 Your expertise will drive operational excellence, system reliability, and continuous improvement
 This role is critical in supporting business continuity and digital transformation initiatives across the organization
 Your background
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Cybersecurity, or a related field
 6–10 years of experience in a similar ICT role
 Strong knowledge of enterprise IT infrastructure, systems, and security
 Experience in multi-site corporate IT environments is a strong advantage
 Fluent English (written and spoken)
 Join Us
 At Ascom, we believe recruitment is a two-way decision.
We are not only looking for someone to join us — we are looking for someone who also chooses us as their next employer.
If you are looking for a role where you can make an impact, work with modern technologies, and contribute to global ICT operations — we would love to hear from you.
